lines.script: You give it premises and a claim, and it searches for a proof: a chain of rule applications from the premises to the claim.

lines.script: nibli answers with one of four verdicts. TRUE. FALSE, meaning not derivable. UNKNOWN, with a reason. And resource exceeded, when a depth, fuel or memory budget runs out.
